findings.title: registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate evaluates predicate against org-aware wrapped model, skipping needed invalidation
findings.body: In update(), the 'original' model is obtained via getById(), which returns the organization-aware wrapper whose isEnabled() returns false when the linked organization is disabled. The cached getForLogin lists, however, are built from the raw database state (raw enabled flag, BROKER_PUBLIC config), so an IDP of a disabled org is still a member of those cached lists. If such an IDP is then updated in a way that changes its cache membership — for example moving it from org A to org B while both orgs are disabled — getLoginPredicate() returns false for both original and updated, so registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate returns early and never invalidates the login caches. The stale cached lists will then keep serving the IDP for org A's login and omit it for org B (e.g. getForLogin(ORG_ONLY, orgAId) returns an IDP no longer linked to org A). The invalidation predicate should be evaluated against the raw model state, not the org-aware wrapper.

findings.title: Cleanup registers removal of literal alias "alias" instead of the created IDP alias
findings.body: In testCacheIDPForLogin (and identically at line 425), the loop creates IDPs named "idp-alias-0" ... "idp-alias-19" but registers cleanup with getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove) — the literal string "alias" rather than the loop variable alias. As a result the 20+ created identity providers are never cleaned up and leak into subsequent tests in the same realm (and the cleanup callback itself references a non-existent resource, which may fail at teardown). The same copy-paste defect exists in testCacheIDPByOrg at line 303.

findings.title: No test coverage for ORG_ONLY/ALL with organizationId=null or for unlinking an IDP from an organization
findings.body: The new getForLogin cache has distinct search keys for organizationId=null (empty string) versus a specific org, and the invalidation logic depends on organizationId transitions (null -> org, org -> null). The test only exercises searches with a concrete org id and only covers linking an IDP to an org (via update + addIdentityProvider); it never covers unlinking (org -> null) or cache hits for the null-organization ORG_ONLY/ALL searches, so regressions in those paths (e.g. the wrapped-predicate issue in registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate) would not be caught.
